scope: Deterministic Rapier simulation on a flat dry test plane at 60Hz. Not a physical Tesla measurement or rendering benchmark.
assumptions: 2200kg, 800kW, suspension/aero/tire data are explicit engineering estimates, not published Tesla measurements.
traction_model: Load-limited force plus Rapier raycast tire impulses; estimated dry mu 1.35, grass 0.65; not measured tire/Pacejka data.
